content.text: {"record_id":"batch.motif.siberian-koryak-texts-bogoras-archive-l926-l1085","source_text_path":"texts/public-domain/siberian/project-gutenberg/koryak-texts-bogoras.md","passage_locator":{"label":"VOWELS. / I                  E / CONSONANTS. / OPEN    COUNTRY.; lines 926-1085","start":"926","end":"1085","translation":"Koryak Texts","notes":"Stable markdown line range generated from canonical text."},"canonical_text":{"quote":"","summary":"In an ongoing storm, Raven-Man enters with frozen boots and says the heavens have a crack. When the storm returns and the first stopper is thrust back, Big-Raven makes a larger stopper and gives more fat; Little-Bird-Man installs it with a mallet, spreads fat and snow around the hole, and the storm becomes calm. Raven-Man is rejected by Miti' for failing to calm the storm, while Little-Bird-Man marries Yini'a-fia'wgut. In a later summer rain, Raven-Man puts the sun in his mouth, making it dark; Can'ai is sent to fetch water and begins singing in the dark.","language":"English with Koryak interlinear
